$comment: Part I Section C — form-structure lens for the procurement procedure and project. `required` follows Schematron severity: procedureType is fatal-mandatory (BR-SC-10); the file reference is optional, but its scheme agency becomes required once a value is entered (BR-OTH-02 is fatal on the emitted element).
title: Procurement procedure
description: Identify the procurement procedure, the project it concerns, and the lots it is divided into.

fields.label: Type of procedure
fields.description: Type of procedure (BR-SC-10, fatal). NOTE: the codelist is not shipped as a .gc, so the picker cannot be populated from ESPD-EDM/codelists — the UI must source it from the EU authority list.

fields.label: File reference number
fields.description: The buyer's own file reference number for this procedure. The XML @schemeAgencyID (BR-OTH-02) is supplied as a constant 'OP' at export, so there is no separate scheme-agency field.

fields.label: Lot identifier
fields.description: Lot identifiers (e.g. LOT-0000). Every selection criterion must reference at least one lot (BR-LOT-41), so a procedure carrying selection criteria needs at least one lot declared here.
